_comment: ARDEN's getting-started tutorial (docs/tutorial-design.md). Each step ticks itself off when its check is met. check.type: moved, left_lander, build_mode, interior_mode, zone (kind), inside, items (ids, all needed), read (Enter), flag (world.guide_flags key). keys: [[caps], action] rows shown under the step. highlight: tutorial_target names, the first visible one is outlined. marker: a compass landmark (lander, base, ice, airlock). modes: only in these game modes (Creative has no simulation, so no systems panel). clip: assets/tutorial/clips/<clip>.ogv for P Show me. said: the voice line id (data/voice_lines.json, habitat) ARDEN says when the step is done.

steps.how: Move the mouse to look. Walk with W A S D; hold Shift to go faster.
Look at the hatch and press E. It lowers into a ramp: walk down it onto Mars.
Press B. The site plan is a top-down view of the ground where you lay out your base. W A S D pans, the wheel zooms, Q and E orbit.
In the Rooms tab pick Living Quarters, then drag a rectangle on flat ground: 2 by 2 cells is plenty. Right-click cancels.
Structure tab: pick Airlock and place it against an outside wall of your room. R turns it so the outer door faces Mars.
Resources tab: pick Solar Array and click a cell near the base. R turns it: the label shows its output, so turn it to the highest.
Pick Ice Extractor: the ground turns blue where there's ice underneath. Place it on bright blue ground. The label shows how much water it will give.
Rooms tab: drag a Life Support room right next to your Living Quarters so they share a wall. A door is added between them by itself.
Press B to leave the plan. Walk to the airlock and press E on the outer door; it cycles, then the inner door opens.
Stand in Living Quarters and press B: you furnish the room in first person. Pick a Crew Bunk, aim at the floor by a wall and click.
In Life Support, press B and place an Oxygen Generator and a Thermal Control Unit. They need power and water: that's what the solar array and the drill are for.
The panel at the side shows power, air, water and heat. Green is fine, amber needs attention, red is urgent. Press Enter when you've had a look.
Press C for the crew screen: who they are, how they feel, and what they need. Z at a bunk sleeps until morning.
Press Esc, then Save & load, and pick a slot. The Field guide in the same menu explains every system.
